profile.headline: Software Engineering
profile.summary:
Principal-level software engineer with 20+ years of experience designing distributed systems, and cloud
platforms. Experienced in agentic systems, AI-powered applications,technical architecture, and platform
modernization

positions.description: Skills: Engineering · Artificial Intelligence (AI)

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Skills: Software Development · Computer Science · Microservices · React.js · Kubernetes · .NET Core · ASP.NET Core

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Skills: Software Development · Computer Science · Microservices

positions.title: Systems Integration Specialist Advisor
positions.description:
Responsible for continued systems support for the Tenet Healthcare account in all of their facilities. My primary responsibilities include Implementing technical solutions and management processes to achieve overall objectives by using the software products, processes, and methodologies.

Perform system design, development and installation of hardware and software implementations. This includes integrating solutions and strategies within the customer environment based on the analysis of customer business goals, objectives, needs, and existing systems infrastructure.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Contribute work to various patient facing products as well as internal web applications using ASP.NET Web technology stack.

Delivered mobile app offering on both Android and iOS platform available in Apple App Store and Google Play Store

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Implemented feature enhancements to Pharmacy Automation and Inventory Management systems using Microsoft WPF and ASP.NET Web API technology stack.

positions.title: Director of Technology at C7 Technologies, LLC
positions.description:
Responsible for managing and executing the company's technical roadmap.

Implemented Push notification service using Microsoft .NET and companion iOS App for Clinicians.

Improved the company’s flagship product by switching the system’s data management * processes from RDBMS to Document based resulting in improved performance and user experience.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Responsible for developing the company’s Employee Management System

positions.title: Senior Application Developer
positions.description: Participated in developing various web applications that empowered HealthTrust Purchasing Group to deliver quality service to their members. For more information about this company please visit http://www.healthtrustcorp.com/

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Responsible for implementing and maintaining the company’s intranet web site and issue tracking software.
Developed and maintained various automated data processing systems using Microsoft .NET and Microsoft SQL Server.

positions.title: Information Systems Resource Specialist
positions.description:
Designing data communication software that provides accessibility to information
stored in various data storage systems. These various data storage systems include
Microsoft SQL Server, Microsoft Access, and SAS Business Analytical Software.

positions.title: Information System Analyst
positions.description:
Responsible for information systems analytical works involving the analysis of
various administrative, reporting, and statistical systems and the development of
methods for adapting these systems to electronic data processing.
